utility.notes: Atwater is a well-documented Merced County city; the City's own Utility Customer Newsletter references PG&E-territory-consistent municipal services. Note: the City of Atwater has its own water/sewer utility billing but electric service in Atwater is PG&E, consistent with the pattern for neighboring Merced in this dataset.

generation_supplier.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Atwater this session.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Atwater/Merced County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Checklist of expedited-review requirements, published on the City's website

required_documents.notes: Per Atwater Municipal Code Section 15.04.130(D): the checklist shall be published on the City's internet website; the applicant may submit the permit application and associated documentation by personal, mailed, or electronic submittal together with any required permit processing and inspection fees. The code text itself does not itemize further documents beyond this checklist.

value: For a small residential rooftop solar energy system eligible for expedited review, only one inspection shall be required, which shall be done in a timely manner and may include a consolidated inspection by the Building Official and Fire Chief
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized

timeline_days.notes: Atwater Municipal Code Section 15.04.130 describes administrative approval of complete applications but does not state an explicit day-count turnaround figure.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy System expedited permitting (Atwater Municipal Code Section 15.04.130)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the authority having jurisdiction
